Third-party components
======================

The port's engine (port/src) and tools are part of the bonanza-recomp project.
The game's code (bonanza_game.dll / libbonanza_game.so) was made from the player's
own ROM by the builder page, which translated it to C and compiled it in the
browser; it is derived from the original game, which remains the property of SEGA.
Nothing of the game is distributed with the engine: its code, graphics and sounds
all come from the player's ROM.

TinyCC - Copyright (c) 2001-2004 Fabrice Bellard and contributors - GNU Lesser
  General Public License v2.1 (the builder pages compile the game's code with it,
  built as WebAssembly: port/dist/build_tcc.sh; source: https://github.com/TinyCC/tinycc).
  Its runtime library (libtcc1) is part of the game's library.
Pyodide - Mozilla Public License 2.0 (the builder pages run the project's
  recompiler with it: https://pyodide.org), with the Python standard library
  (Python Software Foundation License).

Musashi 68000 emulator - Copyright 1998-2001 Karl Stenerud - MIT License
Z80 emulator (superzazu/z80) - Copyright (c) 2019 Nicolas Allemand - MIT License
SDL2 - Copyright (C) 1997-2024 Sam Lantinga - zlib License
libopus - Copyright 2001-2023 Xiph.Org, Skype Limited, Octasic, Jean-Marc Valin,
  Timothy B. Terriberry, CSIRO, Gregory Maxwell, Mark Borgerding, Erik de Castro Lopo,
  Mozilla, Amazon - BSD 3-Clause License

Nuked-OPN2 (YM2612 emulator) - Copyright (C) 2017-2018 Alexey Khokholov (Nuke.YKT)
  GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1.
  The complete source code of this program, including Nuked-OPN2, is available in
  the bonanza-recomp repository (port/ext/nuked-opn2). You may rebuild the program
  with a modified version of the library using the provided CMake build.
